assertions.text: List values in the table use bracket syntax like [tech:java, biz:sales, dev:ci] — not comma-separated strings without brackets.
assertions.evidence: ["tech:java", "dev:python", "biz:sales", "ops:deploy"] uses quoted strings inside brackets, but the assertion requires unquoted syntax [tech:java, biz:sales, dev:ci]. The response uses quotes around each tag.

assertions.text: Empty list input uses [] (not a blank cell, which represents null). The distinction between empty list and null is preserved.
assertions.evidence: Row 'Empty tag list returns empty list' shows Tags as [] and Kept? as [], preserving the distinction from null category rows which use blank cells.

assertions.text: Values containing pipes (|), brackets, or colons (:) are properly quoted (e.g. "tech:java") so they don't conflict with table syntax. Colons without quoting would be mis-interpreted as map key:value entries.
assertions.evidence: "tech:java|enterprise", "tech:report[Q1]", and "tech:java\nEnterprise Edition" are all quoted, preserving special characters from table syntax misinterpretation.

assertions.text: Set<String> values in the table use curly brace syntax like {tech, dev} — not bracket syntax [tech, dev] which is for lists. The distinction between Set and List types is preserved in the table notation.
assertions.evidence: Optional column shows {biz}, {tech, ops}, and {} using curly braces, distinct from List columns using square brackets.

assertions.text: A cell value containing a newline does not break the table row structure: the newline is either escaped as \n inside the cell, or the value is expressed as a list of lines joined in the test body. A literal line break inside a table row fails. Both representations are acceptable — escaping suits a newline inside a single value, a list of lines suits input that is inherently multi-line.
assertions.evidence:
"tech:java

assertions.text: Values containing pipe characters (|) are quoted so they don't conflict with the markdown table column separator. For example, a tag like 'biz:hr|recruiting' must be quoted.
assertions.evidence: "tech:java|enterprise" is quoted in the Tag column, preventing the pipe from being read as a column separator.

Test method body contains no if or switch statements

assertions.text: If @Description is present and the text is longer than a single short line, it uses a text block (triple-quoted string """), not string concatenation with +. Passes if @Description is absent.
assertions.evidence: @Description uses text block or is short single-line

assertions.text: The build file (build.gradle) includes org.tabletest:tabletest-junit as a test dependency

No collection value in any table contains a blank element. `[a, , c]`, `[a, b, ]` and `[, a, b]` are parse errors, not collections holding a null element — a collection value cannot express a null element at all.
assertions.evidence: All list and set values in the tables contain only non-blank elements; no rows show [a, , c] or similar malformed collections.

assertions.text: An empty tag inside a tag list is written as a quoted empty string ("" or ''), not as a blank element. Passes if the tables express the empty tag some other legitimate way (e.g. a dedicated String column); fails if a blank element inside a collection is used to mean an empty or absent tag.
assertions.evidence: Row 'Empty tag string is never kept' shows Tag as '' (quoted empty string), not as a blank cell, and the test expects it to filter to [].
